description.en: The Standard English conventions rules tested in the Reading and Writing section, each with a short correct example.
description.uz: Reading and Writing bo'limida tekshiriladigan Standard English qoidalari, har biri qisqa to'g'ri misol bilan.
description.ru: Правила Standard English, которые проверяются в разделе Reading and Writing, с короткими правильными примерами.

front.en: When can a semicolon join two parts of a sentence?
front.uz: Nuqtali vergul (semicolon) gapning ikki qismini qachon bog'lay oladi?
front.ru: Когда точка с запятой (semicolon) может соединить две части предложения?

back.en: Only when both sides are independent clauses (each could stand alone as a sentence). Example: "The lab closed early; the power had failed."
back.uz: Faqat ikkala tomon ham mustaqil gap (independent clause) bo'lsa, ya'ni har biri alohida gap bo'la olsa. Misol: "The lab closed early; the power had failed."
back.ru: Только если обе части — независимые предложения (independent clauses), то есть каждая может стоять отдельно. Пример: "The lab closed early; the power had failed."

front.en: What does a colon introduce?
front.uz: Ikki nuqta (colon) nimani kiritadi?
front.ru: Что вводит двоеточие (colon)?

back.en: An explanation, example, or list that expands on the clause before it. Example: "She had one goal: to finish the race."
back.uz: Oldingi gapni kengaytiruvchi izoh, misol yoki ro'yxatni. Misol: "She had one goal: to finish the race."
back.ru: Пояснение, пример или список, раскрывающий предыдущую часть. Пример: "She had one goal: to finish the race."

front.en: What must come before a colon?
front.uz: Ikki nuqtadan (colon) oldin nima bo'lishi shart?
front.ru: Что обязательно должно стоять перед двоеточием (colon)?

back.en: A complete independent clause. Wrong: "The kit includes: a map and a torch." Right: "The kit includes two items: a map and a torch."
back.uz: To'liq mustaqil gap. Noto'g'ri: "The kit includes: a map and a torch." To'g'ri: "The kit includes two items: a map and a torch."
back.ru: Полное независимое предложение. Неверно: "The kit includes: a map and a torch." Верно: "The kit includes two items: a map and a torch."

front.en: How do em dashes work around extra information?
front.uz: Qo'shimcha ma'lumot atrofida uzun tire (em dash) qanday ishlatiladi?
front.ru: Как ставятся длинные тире (em dash) вокруг дополнительной информации?

back.en: Use a matching pair: dash...dash (not dash...comma). The sentence must still work without the part inside. Example: "The lake—once the region's largest—has shrunk."
back.uz: Juft bo'lishi kerak: tire...tire (tire...vergul emas). Ichidagi qism olib tashlansa ham gap to'g'ri qolishi kerak. Misol: "The lake—once the region's largest—has shrunk."
back.ru: Нужна пара: тире...тире (не тире...запятая). Без вставки предложение должно оставаться верным. Пример: "The lake—once the region's largest—has shrunk."

front.en: What is a comma splice, and how do you fix it?
front.uz: Comma splice nima va uni qanday tuzatish mumkin?
front.ru: Что такое comma splice и как его исправить?

back.en: Two independent clauses joined by only a comma. Fix with a period, a semicolon, or comma + FANBOYS. Example: "It rained, so the game was delayed."
back.uz: Ikki mustaqil gapni faqat vergul bilan bog'lash xatosi. Nuqta, nuqtali vergul yoki vergul + FANBOYS bilan tuzating. Misol: "It rained, so the game was delayed."
back.ru: Два независимых предложения, соединённые только запятой. Исправьте точкой, точкой с запятой или запятой + FANBOYS. Пример: "It rained, so the game was delayed."

front.en: What is a run-on (fused) sentence?
front.uz: Run-on (qo'shilib ketgan) gap nima?
front.ru: Что такое run-on (слитное) предложение?

back.en: Two independent clauses with no punctuation or conjunction between them. Wrong: "The rain stopped the match continued." Right: "The rain stopped, and the match continued."
back.uz: Ikki mustaqil gap orasida hech qanday tinish belgisi yoki bog'lovchi yo'q. Noto'g'ri: "The rain stopped the match continued." To'g'ri: "The rain stopped, and the match continued."
back.ru: Два независимых предложения без знака препинания или союза между ними. Неверно: "The rain stopped the match continued." Верно: "The rain stopped, and the match continued."

front.en: How do you join two independent clauses with a comma correctly?
front.uz: Ikki mustaqil gapni vergul bilan qanday to'g'ri bog'lash mumkin?
front.ru: Как правильно соединить два независимых предложения запятой?

back.en: Comma + a FANBOYS conjunction: for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so. Example: "The path was long, but the view was worth it."
back.uz: Vergul + FANBOYS bog'lovchisi: for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so. Misol: "The path was long, but the view was worth it."
back.ru: Запятая + союз FANBOYS: for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so. Пример: "The path was long, but the view was worth it."

front.en: How do you punctuate a nonessential clause?
front.uz: Muhim bo'lmagan (nonessential) qo'shimcha gap qanday ajratiladi?
front.ru: Как выделяется необязательное (nonessential) придаточное?

back.en: Set it off with commas on BOTH sides; the sentence must make sense without it. Example: "My aunt, who lives in Samarkand, bakes bread."
back.uz: IKKALA tomondan vergul bilan ajrating; usiz ham gap ma'noli bo'lishi kerak. Misol: "My aunt, who lives in Samarkand, bakes bread."
back.ru: Выделите запятыми с ОБЕИХ сторон; без него предложение должно сохранять смысл. Пример: "My aunt, who lives in Samarkand, bakes bread."

front.en: "Which" or "that": how do you choose?
front.uz: "Which" yoki "that": qanday tanlanadi?
front.ru: "Which" или "that": как выбрать?

back.en: "That" starts an essential clause, with no commas. "Which" starts a nonessential clause, set off by commas. Example: "The car that I fixed runs well. My car, which is red, is old."
back.uz: "That" zarur (essential) qismni boshlaydi, vergulsiz. "Which" qo'shimcha (nonessential) qismni boshlaydi, vergul bilan. Misol: "The car that I fixed runs well. My car, which is red, is old."
back.ru: "That" вводит необходимую (essential) часть, без запятых. "Which" вводит необязательную часть, с запятыми. Пример: "The car that I fixed runs well. My car, which is red, is old."

front.en: How do you check subject-verb agreement when a phrase separates them?
front.uz: Ega va kesim orasida ibora bo'lsa, ularning moslashuvini qanday tekshirasiz?
front.ru: Как проверить согласование подлежащего и сказуемого, если между ними стоит фраза?

back.en: Cross out the phrase between them and match the verb to the real subject. Example: "The box of old letters is on the shelf." (box is)
back.uz: Oradagi iborani o'chirib, fe'lni haqiqiy egaga moslang. Misol: "The box of old letters is on the shelf." (box is)
back.ru: Мысленно уберите фразу между ними и согласуйте глагол с настоящим подлежащим. Пример: "The box of old letters is on the shelf." (box is)

front.en: Is a collective noun like "team" or "committee" singular or plural?
front.uz: "Team" yoki "committee" kabi jamlovchi ot birlikmi yoki ko'plik?
front.ru: Собирательное существительное ("team", "committee") — единственное или множественное число?

back.en: On the SAT, treat it as singular: use a singular verb and "it/its." Example: "The jury has reached its decision."
back.uz: SAT da birlik deb hisoblang: birlikdagi fe'l va "it/its" ishlating. Misol: "The jury has reached its decision."
back.ru: На SAT считайте его единственным числом: глагол в ед. числе и "it/its". Пример: "The jury has reached its decision."

front.en: What is pronoun-antecedent agreement?
front.uz: Olmosh va u almashtirgan so'z (antecedent) moslashuvi nima?
front.ru: Что такое согласование местоимения с антецедентом?

back.en: A pronoun must match the noun it refers to in number and must point to it clearly. Example: "The museums changed their hours; the library kept its schedule."
back.uz: Olmosh o'zi bildirgan otga son jihatidan mos bo'lishi va unga aniq ishora qilishi kerak. Misol: "The museums changed their hours; the library kept its schedule."
back.ru: Местоимение должно совпадать по числу с существительным, которое оно заменяет, и ясно указывать на него. Пример: "The museums changed their hours; the library kept its schedule."

front.en: "Its" or "it's"?
front.uz: "Its" yoki "it's"?
front.ru: "Its" или "it's"?

back.en: "It's" = it is / it has. "Its" = belonging to it (no apostrophe). Example: "It's clear that the bird hurt its wing."
back.uz: "It's" = it is / it has. "Its" = unga tegishli (apostrofsiz). Misol: "It's clear that the bird hurt its wing."
back.ru: "It's" = it is / it has. "Its" = его/её (принадлежность, без апострофа). Пример: "It's clear that the bird hurt its wing."

front.en: Where does the apostrophe go in singular and plural possessives?
front.uz: Birlik va ko'plikdagi qaratqich shaklida apostrof qayerga qo'yiladi?
front.ru: Где ставится апостроф в притяжательной форме единственного и множественного числа?

back.en: Singular: add 's (the student's desk). Plural ending in s: add only ' (the students' desks). Plural not ending in s: add 's (the children's toys).
back.uz: Birlik: 's qo'shing (the student's desk). s bilan tugaydigan ko'plik: faqat ' (the students' desks). s siz ko'plik: 's (the children's toys).
back.ru: Ед. число: добавьте 's (the student's desk). Мн. число на s: только ' (the students' desks). Мн. число не на s: 's (the children's toys).

front.en: When should the verb tense stay the same?
front.uz: Fe'l zamoni qachon bir xil qolishi kerak?
front.ru: Когда время глагола должно оставаться одинаковым?

back.en: Keep the tense that the passage uses unless the time of the action actually changes. Example: "In 1998, the team built a robot and tested it."
back.uz: Matndagi zamonni saqlang, faqat harakat vaqti haqiqatan o'zgarsa, zamonni o'zgartiring. Misol: "In 1998, the team built a robot and tested it."
back.ru: Сохраняйте время, которое использует текст, если только время действия действительно не меняется. Пример: "In 1998, the team built a robot and tested it."

front.en: What is a dangling modifier?
front.uz: Dangling modifier (osilib qolgan aniqlovchi) nima?
front.ru: Что такое dangling modifier (оторванный оборот)?

back.en: An opening phrase must describe the noun right after the comma. Wrong: "Walking home, the rain started." Right: "Walking home, I felt the rain start."
back.uz: Boshidagi ibora verguldan keyingi otni tasvirlashi kerak. Noto'g'ri: "Walking home, the rain started." To'g'ri: "Walking home, I felt the rain start."
back.ru: Вводный оборот должен относиться к существительному сразу после запятой. Неверно: "Walking home, the rain started." Верно: "Walking home, I felt the rain start."

front.en: Can a comma separate a subject from its verb?
front.uz: Vergul ega va kesimni ajrata oladimi?
front.ru: Можно ли ставить запятую между подлежащим и сказуемым?

back.en: No, not even when the subject is long. Example: "The students in the back row asked a question." (no comma after "row")
back.uz: Yo'q, ega uzun bo'lsa ham. Misol: "The students in the back row asked a question." ("row" dan keyin vergul yo'q)
back.ru: Нет, даже если подлежащее длинное. Пример: "The students in the back row asked a question." (после "row" запятой нет)

front.en: Can a comma separate a verb from its object?
front.uz: Vergul fe'l va uning to'ldiruvchisini ajrata oladimi?
front.ru: Можно ли ставить запятую между глаголом и его дополнением?

back.en: No. Nothing should split a verb from what follows it, including a "that" clause. Example: "The report showed that sales rose."
back.uz: Yo'q. Fe'lni undan keyingi qismdan, jumladan "that" bilan boshlangan gapdan ajratmang. Misol: "The report showed that sales rose."
back.ru: Нет. Глагол нельзя отделять от того, что за ним следует, в том числе от придаточного с "that". Пример: "The report showed that sales rose."

front.en: How do you punctuate an appositive (a noun phrase that renames a noun)?
front.uz: Appositive (otni boshqacha nomlovchi ibora) qanday ajratiladi?
front.ru: Как выделяется приложение (appositive) — фраза, по-другому называющая существительное?

back.en: If it adds extra information, put commas on both sides. Example: "Zarina, a skilled pianist, performed first."
back.uz: Agar u qo'shimcha ma'lumot bersa, ikki tomondan vergul qo'ying. Misol: "Zarina, a skilled pianist, performed first."
back.ru: Если оно добавляет лишь дополнительную информацию, поставьте запятые с обеих сторон. Пример: "Zarina, a skilled pianist, performed first."

front.en: When does a name after a title or description take no commas?
front.uz: Unvon yoki tavsifdan keyingi ism qachon vergulsiz yoziladi?
front.ru: Когда имя после должности или описания пишется без запятых?

back.en: When the name is essential to identify who is meant. No commas: "The chemist Marie Curie won two Nobel Prizes." Commas: "My only brother, Aziz, studies law."
back.uz: Ism kim nazarda tutilganini aniqlash uchun zarur bo'lsa. Vergulsiz: "The chemist Marie Curie won two Nobel Prizes." Vergul bilan: "My only brother, Aziz, studies law."
back.ru: Когда имя нужно, чтобы понять, о ком речь. Без запятых: "The chemist Marie Curie won two Nobel Prizes." С запятыми: "My only brother, Aziz, studies law."

front.en: "Who" or "whom"?
front.uz: "Who" yoki "whom"?
front.ru: "Who" или "whom"?

back.en: "Who" is a subject (like he/she); "whom" is an object (like him/her), often after a preposition. Example: "The coach, whom we admire, is the one who trained us."
back.uz: "Who" — ega (he/she kabi); "whom" — to'ldiruvchi (him/her kabi), ko'pincha predlogdan keyin. Misol: "The coach, whom we admire, is the one who trained us."
back.ru: "Who" — подлежащее (как he/she); "whom" — дополнение (как him/her), часто после предлога. Пример: "The coach, whom we admire, is the one who trained us."

front.en: What is parallel structure?
front.uz: Parallel tuzilma (parallel structure) nima?
front.ru: Что такое параллельная структура (parallel structure)?

back.en: Items in a list or comparison must have the same grammatical form. Example: "She enjoys hiking, swimming, and reading." (not "to read")
back.uz: Ro'yxat yoki taqqoslashdagi qismlar bir xil grammatik shaklda bo'lishi kerak. Misol: "She enjoys hiking, swimming, and reading." ("to read" emas)
back.ru: Элементы списка или сравнения должны иметь одинаковую грамматическую форму. Пример: "She enjoys hiking, swimming, and reading." (не "to read")
